intro: Evershine is an Alliance delivery quest beginning with Pilot Bellowfiz near Kharanos. The dwarven siege engine pilot sends travelers westward to Brewnall Village to fetch a potent dwarven brew concocted by Rejold Barleybrew. The liquor doubles as a warming drink and an emergency, high-octane fuel for Bellowfiz's siege engine.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Rejold Barleybrew experiments with his brews. Some of them taste good, some bad, and some...well, some will lay all but the stoutest dwarf flat.
He lives at Brewnall Village, west of Kharanos, and one of his drinks, Evershine, is what I want. It'll help keep me warm while I'm on the cold road.
And...the blessed stuff burns so hot I can throw it in Jetsteam's furnace for a burst of power! That little tactic has gotten me out of more than one tight spot.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Bellowfiz needs some of my Evershine? Hm...all right.
